mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) of more than 0.5 percentage points over the past 3 months signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS decline > 0.5pp are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 10.0%, it signals that the Federal Reserve will implement monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE > 10.0% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) is rising (month-over-month increase > 0.2%) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1.0%, it signals that the Federal Reserve is maintaining an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods meeting the interaction condition are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a manufacturing recovery (INDPRO > 100 and rising for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 will have positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: manufacturing recovery (INDPRO > 100 and rising for 2 months)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods of manufacturing recovery (INDPRO > 100 and rising for 2 months) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A positive GDP growth rate (GDPC1) in the latest quarter (i.e., current quarter value > previous quarter value) signals improving economic conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods of positive GDP growth (GDPC1) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year inflation rate (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals that the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% (yoy) are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When employment growth (PAYEMS) is accelerating (month-over-month increase > 0.5%) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is rising (month-over-month increase > 0.3%), it signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns in periods meeting the interaction condition are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market recovery (HOUST > 580.0 and rising for two consecutive months), the S&P 500 will have positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: housing market recovery (HOUST > 580.0 and rising for 2 months)
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns in periods of housing market recovery (HOUST > 580.0 and rising for 2 months) are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window < 0.03.
